B_monday_weekend_drift.one_line: The 2020s Monday/weekend drift is real in-sample (only candidate to beat the multiplicity bar, P=0.06) but GSPC Mondays averaged -11 to -16bp (t to -4.65) from 1950-1989 and 0.2 to -1.9bp in 2000-2019 - a sign-flipping anomaly with zero economic anchor is a regime bet, not an edge; the ES leg is additionally 5 weekends (58% of PnL, OOS 0.02 without them).
